dev_build.label: Windows x64 dev build (unsigned)
dev_build.notes: Clean (non-dirty) unsigned Windows exe on public R2 from git HEAD 274877db. Not Authenticode-signed; signed update-channel manifest still 404.

download.notes: Signed stable channel still 404. Public CTAs may link the unsigned Windows dev build on R2; do not claim signed stable.

metrics.notes: LOC is src/ Rust only. Test count is #[test] attributes, not a fresh full-suite pass/fail run.

engine.js: SassyScript tree-walker (production default); optional bytecode VM via "use vm;"; Boa removed
engine.layout_paint: Hand-rolled CPU layout + paint (production); taffy/parley/vello linked as probe/chrome helpers
engine.http: HTTP/1.1 (TLS-spoofed) + HTTP/2 document navigation; HTTP/3 planned

items.name: Rust rendering engine
items.detail: Custom layout + paint, no Chromium. Real sites still incomplete; see smoke scoreboard.

items.name: HTTPS / TLS (Chrome-132 JA3)
items.detail: rustls + Chrome-132 fingerprint spoof.

items.name: HTTP/1.1 + HTTP/2
items.detail: HTTP/2 navigation with HTTP/1.1 fallback; cookies/referer/gzip/br.

items.name: HTTP/3 / QUIC
items.detail: UI shows disabled toggle; not implemented.

items.name: Tabbed navigation + groups
items.detail: Tabs, mute, age tooltip, kind label, group collapse.

items.name: Bookmarks + history
items.detail: Folders, rename, domain chips, per-entry delete, retention.

items.name: SassyScript JS engine
items.detail: ~60% ES2020; tree-walker production default; bytecode VM opt-in. Boa removed.

items.name: CSS cascade + flex/grid
items.detail: Cascade improving; flex/grid via taffy path still incomplete vs modern sites.

items.name: DOM events / forms / timers / rAF
items.detail: Interactive egui shell: timers, rAF, click/keyboard, forms, CSS transitions.

items.name: fetch / storage / history.pushState
items.detail: Real implementations wired.

items.name: AbortController / MutationObserver
items.detail: AbortController wired; MutationObserver delivers coarse childList records on tick after observe().

items.name: Private / incognito mode
items.detail: History suppressed + separate cookie jar + localStorage/sessionStorage partitions (cleared on exit). Image HTTP disk cache disabled in private mode (memory-only; cleared on enter/exit). No general HTTP response disk cache yet.

items.name: IndexedDB
items.detail: In-memory open/createObjectStore/createIndex/put/get/getAll/getAllKeys/clear + index.get + store openCursor/continue (forward primary-key order); no key ranges or disk persistence.

items.name: Dedicated Worker
items.detail: Same-thread host: new Worker(url), postMessage/onmessage/terminate for data: and http(s) scripts. No importScripts, transferables, SharedWorker, or ServiceWorker.

items.name: Canvas 2D
items.detail: Live + DomBridge getContext('2d') share pixmap rasterizer with fillRect/clearRect/path/text plus translate/scale/resetTransform; rotate/clip/gradients still stubbed.

items.name: video / WebGL / WebRTC / ServiceWorker
items.detail: Not implemented. Dedicated Worker (same-thread) is separate and partial.

items.name: WebAssembly runtime
items.detail: Isolated wasm runtime for in-page code.

items.name: Built-in ad blocker
items.detail: EasyList + tracking + cosmetic.

items.name: Password vault
items.detail: ChaCha20-Poly1305 + Argon2id + strength meter.

items.name: Cookie inventory
items.detail: Ctrl+Shift+K; raw Set-Cookie wire view.

items.name: Page trust sandbox
items.detail: Capability gating for clipboard/downloads/popups.

items.name: Fingerprint poisoning
items.detail: Canvas/WebGL/audio/fonts; Hunter Mode.

items.name: Behavioral mimicry L4
items.detail: Per-tab + EvolutionRequest channel.

items.name: Family profiles
items.detail: Multi-user profiles + pairing approval lifecycle.

items.name: Telemetry-free by default
items.detail: No analytics by default.

items.name: Native VPN (WireGuard)
items.detail: Feature-map commitment; not product-complete.

items.name: Sandboxed renderer process
items.detail: Per-tab OS process isolation.

items.name: PDF viewer (+ annotate)
items.detail: View/search/annotate path present; not Acrobat parity.

items.name: Image viewer (+ basic edit)
items.detail: View + crop/resize/levels/filters. Photoshop/Photopea replacement still In planning (FEATURE-MAP).

items.name: RAW photo decode
items.detail: RAW formats open in viewer stack; full demosaic/Lightroom parity not claimed.

items.name: DOCX / ODT / RTF

items.name: XLSX / ODS / CSV

items.name: PPTX / ODP

items.name: PDB / MOL / SDF / chemistry
items.detail: Pure-Rust chemistry + 3D views. Not ChemDraw feature-parity.

items.name: DICOM

items.name: 3D meshes (STL/OBJ/glTF/…)
items.detail: Interactive mesh inspection.

items.name: DXF + CAD interchange
items.detail: DXF + STEP/IGES/3MF/OpenSCAD viewers shipped; full CAD suite still expanding.

items.name: Archives (zip/7z/tar/gz)
items.detail: Browse/extract/create/Mark for Removal.

items.name: EPUB / MOBI

items.name: Web3 risk educator
items.detail: Five risk tiers + EIP-1193 MetaMask middleware path.

items.name: MCP diagnostics + Control Center

items.name: Encrypted MCP key vault
items.detail: Passphrase-encrypted; never plaintext in ai.toml.

items.name: Multi-agent orchestrator
items.detail: Voice / Coder / Auditor / Orchestrator wired.
